text: Okay... suit's holding. That's a start. Hang on. Is that a light over there?
Oh, wow. Someone built a whole gym out here.
Uh... was that there a second ago?
Oh, hey. Give me a second. It's been quiet around here.
I'm Orbit. So... you found my gym. Want the quick tour?
Pick something you'd like to work on. I'll meet you there.
Bring me a clip from whichever angle you've got. I'll tell you what I can see, and what I'd need another look at.
Have a look through the feedback, then finish and step back into the park. That's when I log your activity. No rush.
Your practice keeps the lights on. That's our story, anyway. Five activity days earn twenty energy credits. The missions tab has the details.
Too loud? Too much movement? Settings is up there. Your journal keeps this visit's clips and notes. You can delete them whenever you like.
And those little consoles? They're for a break. Try the lights, the memory board, or the orbit dial. Just for fun. They don't count as a workout.
Got it. Let me watch that through.
Okay, I've marked a few moments. Tap a time and we'll look at that bit.
I can see some of it. Let's look at those bits first. I've put down what would help me see the rest.
I'm not getting a clear view of you here. Check the recording tips below. We can try again.
There you go. First one done. Your notes are in the journal if you want another look later.
